If you want to get the best in hair care, The Final Cut is the destination for you in Belfast. With over 20 years of experience in the beauty industry, the artists at this premium salon are highly qualified and know how to make you feel awesome with their range of expert hair care solutions.
• Hair styling and colouring specialists
• Unisex salon for men, women and children
• Featured in hair and beauty publications
• ghd straightening, curling and styling
• NVQ level 3 certified and City & Guilds Distinctions
Great value services at reasonable prices
“Great salon with great friendly staff, had my hair cut and coloured and the result was amazing! I’ve never felt so good coming out of a salon.”

"So so pleased with my cut and colour. Andrew and the girls were so welcoming and friendly, would recommend them highly. I won't be going anywhere else from now on."
"I have finally found a wonderful hairdresser. At last I have a style that makes my fine hair look healthy and blonde without any gold. Thank you Andrew and Louise, two very talented people."

With a 5 star salon rating from the trusted people at the Good Salon Guide, you can rely on our expert hair stylists to provide you with the advice and guidance as well as the skills needed to complete your look. When you choose us, you can rest assured knowing you are in the best hands.

At The Final Cut we only use and supply Wella and Schwarzkopf Professionals products, as we believe they are the best on the market and after working with them and using their products for over 30 years we can assure our clients that they will get the best result.

The hair experts at The Final Cut are committed to delivering you the style you want using the most up-to-date hair cutting and hair colouring techniques. Your hairstyle is a vital part of your appearance and having great hair will give you the added confidence to walk with your head held high.

At The Final Cut, we have a wide range of services, including colouring and cutting . We are located in Belfast and have a great track record serving the local community. Book an appointment with us for a free consultation, so that you can find your dream look.
